newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi stocks edge higher, Reliance in spotlight.
newsitem.headline: Delhi stocks edge higher, Reliance in spotlight.

text.p: Investors counting on a bonus issue snapped up shares in Reliance Industries and helped to push Delhi shares higher in early trade on Wednesday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange Benchmark Index was up 1.13 points to 812.23 after 30 minutes of trade. Reliance, which jumped 2.3 percent on Tuesday, added another 0.75 rupee to 318.25 on sizeable volumes.
